summary: You start the ASP.NET Core layer: a gateway with POST /api/ask that checks the request, forwards it to the Python service and returns the answer with its sources. Failures of the other service become 502, 503 and 504, settings come from configuration, and tests use a stub for Python.

items.text: Create the AskGateway and AskGateway.Tests projects and a .gitignore
Write the models and the snake_case JSON options
Write the typed client with the failure mapping
Write Program.cs with the endpoint, validation and configuration
Write the gateway tests with a stub and see 7 pass
Ask through .NET, then try a bad request, Python off and its database off
Add the README section, then commit and push
